mapper.sql: select a.appraisal_id, a.plan_id, p.plan_name, p.cycle_type, p.plan_status, p.self_weight, a.user_id, u.login_name, u.user_name, a.dept_id, d.dept_name, a.reviewer_id, r.user_name as reviewer_name, a.self_score, a.leader_score, a.final_score, a.grade, a.self_comment, a.leader_comment, a.appraisal_status, a.self_time, a.review_time, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, case when a.appraisal_status = '2' then (select count(1) + 1 from perf_appraisal k where k.plan_id = a.plan_id and k.appraisal_status = '2' and k.final_score > a.final_score) end as plan_rank from perf_appraisal a inner join perf_plan p on p.plan_id = a.plan_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.dept_id left join sys_user r on r.user_id = a.reviewer_id
mapper.select: order by a.plan_id desc, a.final_score desc, a.appraisal_id

select a.grade as grade, count(1) as total, round(avg(a.final_score), 2) as avgScore from perf_appraisal a inner join perf_plan p on p.plan_id = a.plan_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.dept_id
group by a.grade order by a.grade

select item_id, appraisal_id, indicator_id, indicator_name, indicator_type, scoring_standard, weight, self_score, leader_score, order_num from perf_appraisal_item where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} order by order_num, item_id
select count(1) from perf_appraisal where plan_id = #{planId} and appraisal_status != '2'
mapper.insert: insert into perf_appraisal(plan_id, user_id, dept_id, reviewer_id, appraisal_status, create_by, create_time) values(#{planId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{reviewerId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())

insert into perf_appraisal_item(appraisal_id, indicator_id, indicator_name, indicator_type, scoring_standard, weight, order_num) values
(#{item.appraisalId}, #{item.indicatorId}, #{item.indicatorName}, #{item.indicatorType}, #{item.scoringStandard}, #{item.weight}, #{item.orderNum})
mapper.update: update perf_appraisal_item set self_score = #{selfScore} where item_id = #{itemId} and appraisal_id = #{appraisalId}
update perf_appraisal_item set leader_score = #{leaderScore} where item_id = #{itemId} and appraisal_id = #{appraisalId}

update perf_appraisal set self_comment = #{selfComment}, self_score = #{selfScore}, appraisal_status = #{appraisalStatus}, self_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} and appraisal_status = '0'

update perf_appraisal set leader_comment = #{leaderComment}, leader_score = #{leaderScore}, final_score = #{finalScore}, grade = #{grade}, appraisal_status = '2', review_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} and appraisal_status = '1'
update perf_appraisal set leader_comment = #{leaderComment}, appraisal_status = '0', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} and appraisal_status = '1'
update perf_appraisal set reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} and appraisal_status != '2'
mapper.delete: delete from perf_appraisal where appraisal_id = #{appraisalId} and appraisal_status != '2'
